+# Validate the AUR source recipe on Arch Linux when manually dispatched.
+# Provenance: Arch's makepkg and Rust packaging guidelines.
+name: AUR package
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    container: archlinux:latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Install Arch build dependencies
+        run: |
+          pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed base-devel git rust pkgconf \
+            libxkbcommon libxkbcommon-x11 libx11 wayland vulkan-icd-loader libglvnd
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Check AUR metadata
+        run: |
+          useradd -m builder
+          chown -R builder:builder "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
+          su builder -c "cd '$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/aur' && makepkg --printsrcinfo" > /tmp/camcraft.srcinfo
+          diff -u aur/.SRCINFO /tmp/camcraft.srcinfo
+      - name: Build and test Arch package
+        run: su builder -c "cd '$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/aur' && makepkg --noconfirm"
+      - name: Check package contents
+        run: |
+          bsdtar -tf aur/camcraft-*.pkg.tar.zst | grep -E '(^|/)usr/lib/camcraft/camcraft-ui$'
+          bsdtar -tf aur/camcraft-*.pkg.tar.zst | grep -E '(^|/)usr/share/applications/camcraft.desktop$'
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: arch-package
+          path: aur/camcraft-*.pkg.tar.zst
+          if-no-files-found: error

 cargo build --release -p camcraft-post --bin post          # standalone post processor

+### Arch Linux package
+
+The `aur/` directory contains a source package recipe for the tagged
+CamCraft release. On Arch Linux, build and install it with:
+
+```sh
+cd aur
+makepkg -si
+```
+
+The recipe installs the desktop app, command-line tools, and assets together.
+Publishing the recipe to the AUR is a separate step after its Arch build is
+validated.
+
 Windows, Linux, and macOS desktop releases are built on GitHub. The core
 crates also build and test on macOS, and the post engine compiles for
 `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.

+## #72: Arch Linux source package
+
+- Add a `camcraft` source recipe under `aur/`, pinned to tag `v0.12.1` and
+  the source archive's SHA-256. Arch builds against its own libraries, and the
+  tag includes `Cargo.lock`; `prepare()` fetches locked Rust dependencies and
+  `build()` runs offline. Keep the binary, CLI, and adjacent assets under
+  `/usr/lib/camcraft` with commands in `/usr/bin`, as in the DEB and RPM.
+  Dropped `camcraft-bin` for this slice: the current GitHub release has no
+  Linux binary asset for every patch tag, while a source tag exists. The AUR
+  entry itself will be published after an Arch build validates the recipe.
+- Validate `aur/` in a separate manually dispatched workflow on an Arch Linux container:
+  compare `makepkg --printsrcinfo` with the checked-in `.SRCINFO`, run
+  `makepkg` through its build and test stages, inspect the package contents,
+  and upload the result. Keep this out of `release.yml` because the source
+  recipe follows tagged versions and AUR updates, while `release.yml`
+  assembles assets only for a CamCraft release. Manual dispatch also follows
+  the repository policy against running Actions for every PR.
+- The first Arch build reached `ld.lld` but could not resolve Flecs C symbols.
+  The likely cause is makepkg's default LTO compiling the bundled Flecs C into
+  GCC LTO objects that rust-lld cannot consume. Set `options=('!lto')` in the
+  package recipe, as the Arch Rust package guidelines prescribe for mixed
+  Rust/C projects, and verify the fix with another Arch package build.

+# CamCraft source package for Arch Linux and the AUR.
+# Provenance: Arch Linux Rust package guidelines and CamCraft's release layout.
+pkgname=camcraft
+pkgver=0.12.1
+pkgrel=1
+pkgdesc='Computer-aided manufacturing application'
+arch=('x86_64')
+url='https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft'
+license=('MIT')
+depends=('glibc' 'libgcc' 'libxkbcommon' 'libxkbcommon-x11' 'libx11'
+         'wayland' 'vulkan-icd-loader' 'libglvnd')
+makedepends=('cargo' 'pkgconf')
+# Flecs compiles bundled C with cc-rs; Arch GCC LTO objects cannot be linked
+# by rust-lld, leaving every Flecs C symbol undefined at the final link.
+options=('!lto')
+source=("$pkgname-$pkgver.tar.gz::$url/archive/refs/tags/v$pkgver.tar.gz"
+        'camcraft.desktop')
+sha256sums=('3b36cfef889001d3692d079a99db3b51fa313737782169519144564dd61c66a6'
+            '55fc7185f3f84c3db22e4210e049f1838c3ace8c158c4f20cebed4ce31b44621')
+
+prepare() {
+    cd "$srcdir/Camcraft-$pkgver"
+    export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable
+    cargo fetch --locked --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')"
+}
+
+build() {
+    cd "$srcdir/Camcraft-$pkgver"
+    export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target
+    cargo build --frozen --release -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post
+}
+
+check() {
+    cd "$srcdir/Camcraft-$pkgver"
+    export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target
+    cargo test --frozen -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --lib
+}
+
+package() {
+    cd "$srcdir/Camcraft-$pkgver"
+    install -dm755 "$pkgdir/usr/lib/camcraft/assets" "$pkgdir/usr/bin"
+    for _binary in camcraft-ui camcraft-cli post; do
+        install -Dm755 "target/release/$_binary" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/camcraft/$_binary"
+    done
+    for _asset in posts machines ui scripts themes; do
+        cp -a "assets/$_asset" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/camcraft/assets/$_asset"
+    done
+    for _pair in camcraft:camcraft-ui camcraft-cli:camcraft-cli camcraft-post:post; do
+        _command=${_pair%%:*}
+        _binary=${_pair#*:}
+        printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/lib/camcraft/%s "$@"\n' "$_binary" > "$pkgdir/usr/bin/$_command"
+        chmod 755 "$pkgdir/usr/bin/$_command"
+    done
+    install -Dm644 "$srcdir/camcraft.desktop" "$pkgdir/usr/share/applications/camcraft.desktop"
+    install -Dm644 assets/ui/cube.png "$pkgdir/usr/share/pixmaps/camcraft.png"
+    install -Dm644 LICENSE "$pkgdir/usr/share/licenses/camcraft/LICENSE"
+    install -Dm644 TESTING.md "$pkgdir/usr/share/doc/camcraft/TESTING.md"
+}
